notes.title: v1.0.1 Bugfix
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280090/830f3fdab2086f6728240937cc4e2438f3a9c1ce.png


 Fixed an issue where the effect of the relic Flower Vase would not trigger on tiles occupied by enemy units.
 Fixed a UI clipping issue in certain language settings.
 Improved translation quality for some in-game texts.


If you find any bugs, feel free to contact us at vasrakgames@gmail.com. Thank you!

notes.title: Vasrak Kingdom: Battle on the Frontier - DEMO ON STEAM!
notes.content:
Demo Version Released!  
We are thrilled to announce the release of the demo version of Vasrak Kingdom: Battle on the Frontier.  
We’ll be improving the game further based on feedback from our players!  

What is Vasrak Kingdom: Battle on the Frontier?  
  
 A unique blend of deck-building and Tic-Tac-Toe: Summon and position soldiers to capture lines and defeat your enemies.  
 Real-time strategy: Make quick decisions in a dynamic battlefield to achieve victory.  
 Story and worldbuilding: Dive into a world of resource wars featuring adorable hamster characters!  
  

What’s included in the demo?  
  
 Learn the basics of the game through an early combat tutorial.  
 Test your strategies in battles using a variety of soldier cards.  
 Some features will be added in the full version!  
  

What’s next?  
The full version will include more cards, units, an expanded story, and new features. Your feedback from the demo will help us make the game even better!  

We need your feedback!  
After playing the demo, please send us your thoughts or suggestions via email.  
Email: vasrakgames@gmail.com  

Your valuable feedback is a huge help in improving the game.  
Download the demo now on Steam and start your adventure in the Vasrak Kingdom! 🎮  

Thank you! 🙌
